import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
ROOT=Path('/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-251-20261014')
OUT=Path('/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-251-integration-review')
GATES=Path('/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-251-checks/final')
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
receipts=json.loads((GATES/'receipts.json').read_text())
expected=[['just','render-pages'],['just','validate'],['just','test'],['just','lint'],['just','vendored-check'],['git','diff','--check']]
assert [x['command'] for x in receipts]==expected
bound=[]
for receipt in receipts:
    path=Path(receipt['log_path']);actual=sha(path)
    bound.append({**receipt,'actual_log_sha256':actual,'log_hash_match':actual==receipt['log_sha256']})
core=json.loads((GATES/'core-input-hashes.json').read_text())
current={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):sha(p) for directory in ['src','tests','conf','data/pathways','data/identifier_authorities','history'] for p in (ROOT/directory).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts}
changed=[p for p,h in core.items() if current.get(p)!=h];added=sorted(current.keys()-core.keys());removed=sorted(core.keys()-current.keys())
audit=json.loads((OUT/'record-integration-audit.json').read_text());visual=json.loads((OUT/'visual-review.json').read_text())
unchanged={'record':sha(ROOT/'data/pathways/gentisate-degradation-i.yaml')==audit['target_sha256']==visual['record_sha256'],'page':sha(ROOT/'pages/records/MetaCyc_PWY-6223.html')==audit['page_sha256']==visual['page_sha256'],'kgx_nodes':sha(ROOT/'pages/downloads/nodes.tsv')==sha(OUT/'kgx-current/nodes.tsv'),'kgx_edges':sha(ROOT/'pages/downloads/edges.tsv')==sha(OUT/'kgx-current/edges.tsv')}
for name,staged in [('sources','source'),('ontology','ontology')]:unchanged[name]=sha(ROOT/f'data/identifier_authorities/{name}.json')==sha(OUT/f'{staged}.replayed.json')
no_runtime_changes=not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','cd42a526b06ce531e8326a2717d54d7ff770bd2b','--','src','tests','scripts','justfile','pyproject.toml','conf/identifier_policy.yaml'],cwd=ROOT)
report={'reviewed_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'gate_receipts':bound,'core_input_count':len(core),'core_input_sha256':sha(GATES/'core-input-hashes.json'),'core_changed':changed,'core_added':added,'core_removed':removed,'reviewed_artifacts_unchanged':unchanged,'runtime_schema_tests_builders_policy_unchanged':no_runtime_changes,'test_result_tail':(GATES/'just-test.log').read_text()[-500:],'validation_log':(GATES/'just-validate.log').read_text(),'passed':all(x['exit_code']==0 and x['log_hash_match'] for x in bound) and not (changed or added or removed) and all(unchanged.values()) and no_runtime_changes}
(OUT/'final-gate-acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
assert report['passed'],report
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'gates':len(receipts),'core_inputs':len(core),'test_result_tail':report['test_result_tail']}))
